messages:
Evan R: Just shared updated Trace Drilldown comps focused on export permutations and corr-id affordances. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/trace-drilldown-new Mock includes in-row copy, frame snippets, and an export flyout. Quick eyes?
Mei (Design): Love the in-row copy and snippet drawer. Two quick nits: the copy icon needs sr-only text for screen readers, and the chevron collapse affordance is low contrast at small sizes.
Ola (Eng): Noted. For copy we should use `navigator.clipboard.writeText` with a fallback iframe method for older browsers. Copying very large frame blobs should be chunked so the UI thread isn't blocked.
Hector - PM: Product preference: primary CTA = "Download summary (CSV)" for quick triage. Secondary = "Download full trace (ndjson)" and tertiary = "Download selected frames (JSON)". Can we show size estimate before confirming full export?
Ola (Eng): Yes, we'll estimate size server-side and show it in the modal. Also implement streaming for full exports and a cancel button. Backend will emit progress via SSE.
Mei (Design): Accessibility: export action needs `aria-expanded` toggling and the export menu must be reachable by keyboard after focusing the trace title. Tooltip delays feel slow on mobile — reduce to 300ms.
a11y-checker: Checklist: 1) Copy button: role=button, aria-label="Copy correlation id" + sr-only live status on success. 2) Export menu: aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded toggled. 3) Long exports: polite live region announces "Export started" and link when ready. 4) Focus outline visible for all icons.
Evan R: For permalinks: hosted orgs get stable permalinks (mask raw ids), private orgs get ephemeral share tokens (1h TTL). Toast copy text should differ: "Permalink copied" vs "Permalink copied (expires in 1h)".
Ola (Eng): Implementation detail: /api/v1/shares creates signed token for private orgs. We'll attach `X-Export-Size` header for estimate and require confirm for >10MB. Also add org-level feature flag to disable full exports.
Mei (Design): Microcopy suggestions: "Download summary (CSV)", "Download full trace (may be large)", "Download selection". For copy to clipboard toast: include small action link "Open in new tab" when permalinkable.
Hector - PM: Keyboard shortcuts: propose when a trace row is focused: `C` copy corr-id, `S` download summary, `F` toggle frame focus, `P` copy permalink. Make sure single-letter shortcuts are scoped to focus and documented in help overlay.
Ola (Eng): We'll scope via focus ring and a JS guard. Note conflicts with global shortcuts (e.g., G). We'll provide a conflict matrix in the spec.
ci-bot: Design snapshot uploaded: https://s3.company/internal/trace-drilldown-v5.png
Mei (Design): I'll push updated frames with higher-contrast chevrons, sr-only copy labels, and compact layout for dense sessions. Also add a no-JS fallback that opens the share modal.
Evan R: Thanks. Hector, can you schedule a 30-min dev handoff and add the a11y checklist to the ticket acceptance criteria?
Hector - PM: Scheduled Thu 11am. Acceptance criteria I'll add: inline copy + toast with sr-only, export menu with size estimates + cancelable progress + org flags, permalink flows per org type, keyboard shortcuts doc, accessibility checklist attached. Thanks all.
